summary: Frontend E2E test of NEW journey planner on /transport-public: origin→destination input with Google Places, auto-prefill from geoloc, journey-result with bus vs VTC comparison, multi-leg bus itinerary including L2→L1 correspondance, verdict banner, and 'Réserver en VTC' navigation. All target selectors and flows pass 100%. No bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: GooglePlacesInput: parent passes only `value` (string) and `onSelect`; if user types but never picks an autocomplete result, jFrom/jTo stay as the previous object so the planner won't fire — acceptable but minor UX gap (no inline hint that user must pick a suggestion).
Journey useEffect depends on jFrom & jTo object identity; if either is updated with same lat/lng but a new object, the API will be re-called. Low priority but could be memoized with lat/lng deps.
Like in iter175, the verdict 'Le bus reste 0 € moins cher' edge-case still possible if busMin==vtcMin and fares match exactly; consider an 'égalité' branch.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tested on preview URL with geoloc set near Université des Antilles (16.227,-61.518). Login via /login → 'Ou choisir une autre option' → 'Email' → fill 'vous@exemple.com'/'••••••' inputs → 'Se connecter'. journey-planner is at top of /transport-public. jFrom auto-prefilled to {address:'Ma position actuelle', lat, lng}. To trigger autocomplete, type a long query (e.g. 'Aeroport Pole Caraibes Guadeloupe'), wait ~3s for .pac-container, then ArrowDown+Enter. Result with destination near Aéroport Pôle Caraïbes returned: Bus ~58 min / 3.00€ / '1 correspondance' (4 legs: walk → L2 Univ→Place Victoire → L1 Place Victoire→Aéroport → walk), VTC ~15 min / 14.75€, verdict 'Le VTC vous fait gagner ~43 min · surcoût VTC 11,75 €'. journey-book-vtc-btn navigates to /course?mode=standard. Second run with destination 'Centre Hospitalier Universitaire Abymes' resolved to a closer Plus Code (near Place de la Victoire) and produced a direct L2 itinerary (3 legs) — also coherent. Rest of page (transport-fare-*, compare-vtc-*, continue-vtc-btn) renders correctly under the planner.
validated_flows: journey-planner panel renders at top of /transport-public ✅
journey-from-input auto-prefilled with 'Ma position actuelle' via geoloc ✅
journey-to-input accepts text + Google Places autocomplete dropdown appears ✅
journey-result displays Bus (~min, fare, direct/N correspondances) and VTC (~min, fare, porte à porte) columns ✅
journey-verdict banner shows correct 'gagner ~X min · surcoût VTC' messaging ✅
journey-legs renders multi-leg itinerary with walk + bus line badges (color, code, stops, minutes) ✅
Correspondance scenario (Univ Antilles → Aéroport Pôle Caraïbes): legs include L2 then L1 with '1 correspondance' label ✅
Direct scenario (Univ Antilles → near Place Victoire): legs include walk → L2 → walk with 'direct' label ✅
Page regression: stops list, transport-fare-*, compare-vtc-*, continue-vtc-btn still render correctly below the planner ✅
rca of the issue: No bugs. New journey planner feature is functioning as specified — including correspondance routing (L2→L1) on real Google Places coordinates.
